name: path-ride
title: Path Ride
description: A line draws itself along a curve with the text riding behind its head, then the curve pulls taut and the text settles on a straight, centered baseline.
useWhen: A tagline or a short phrase should travel across the frame before it settles, leading the eye from one side to the other.
You want text on a path, with each letter turned to the curve, and a clean readable line at the end.
The motion should follow a custom route: pass any SVG path in 1280×720 space.
avoidWhen: The line should be an accent on its own, with no text riding it: use squiggle.
The text should loop around a closed ring: use ring-text.
The text should scroll in a straight strip: use infinite-marquee.
author: Remocn
